title: form.submit raises valueerror when running a bulk import
body:
Environment

Running Lattice 3.0.2 on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS against eu-west-2.

Steps

How to trigger it:
* Start by running a bulk import.
* Set the machine timezone to UTC+2.
* Wait for the failure and read the log.

Expected

No traceback; running a bulk import normally takes a few seconds.

Actual

A time just before midnight is what is rejected. Our machines are set to a timezone ahead of UTC and
the date flips at midnight.

Frequency

Happens every time.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:48 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:91 in on_import
lattice/io/batch.py:56 in run_import
lattice/ui/form.py:257 in submit
ValueError: invalid date '2026-03-29 02:30'
